content.short: Royal lets anyone invest in music and earn royalties with artists.
content.description: Royal is a music marketplace where anyone can invest in music projects and earn royalties alongside the artists involved. The platform envisions a future where fans and creators co-own music and share in the financial rewards, aligning incentives across the ecosystem. Royal also champions artistic freedom, helping musicians retain independence and creative control even as fan support propels their careers forward. By connecting fans, artists, and investors, Royal aims to redefine ownership in music.
